testcase.name: ATDD-VPSPG-001: production dependency graph and readiness contain PostgreSQL/Node only, with no Cloudflare path
ATDD-VPSPG-002: PostgreSQL 16 clean and supported-upgrade migrations preserve identities and transactional invariants
ATDD-VPSPG-003: concurrent claim/fencing, outbox reconcile, and immutable bounded blob contracts hold
ATDD-VPSPG-004: Nitro builds and starts a Node target and authenticated routes work without Cloudflare bindings
ATDD-VPSPG-005: one runtime env and one credential allowlist reject inline, unknown, escaped, corporate Google, and Cloudflare settings
ATDD-VPSPG-006: private benchmark enforces consent, role/deny isolation, offline hard oracle, and unconditional cleanup using synthetic fixtures only
ATDD-VPSPG-007: dashboard and candidate list render the same server-derived 55 percent milestone in accessible progress bars

ATDD-VPSPG-008: frozen HR-approved profile snapshot is the only profile basis and missing approval, checksum mismatch, or implicit regeneration fail closed before pipeline input reads and provider calls
ATDD-VPSPG-009: reference ABC/result and extracted anchors never create or mutate the profile and never reach provider payload, Drive snapshot, or blob store
ATDD-VPSPG-010: exactly two owner-only generated PDFs are retained privately until review/deadline, then deletion is proven and incomplete cleanup is terminal RED
ATDD-VPSPG-011: four canonical E2E run through the assembled Node web/worker and durable PostgreSQL on one build/config/fixture identity, not via in-memory/SQLite controller
